BiblicalUsage: Hareph is named once, as the father of Beth-gader, in the genealogy of Caleb. Chronicles counts him among the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe one line can carry a father's whole legacy: Hareph's son became a town's name.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
